title: Naanum Oru Azhagi
description: Krishnamma went tution to pozhikarayan. Krishnamma studies well and get passed in exams. Krishnamma and pozhikarayan loves each other. Krishnamma marries durai pandi when pozhikarayan went for his work. Duraipandi sent his wife krishnamma to her mother house because of infertility. When krishnamma in her home krishnamma and pozhikarayan had an affair and krishnamma get praganent. Knowing this Duarai pandi tries to kill krishnamma but elders in the town stop this. But Krishnamma dies during herbaby shower with unborn baby
